rows.label: qst650515_msg0001
rows.name:
This is the World Tree...
the 7th Outer Perimeter Airport.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0002
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] They call it an 'airport'...
so I did wonder if perhaps...

rows.label: qst650515_msg0003
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] Their "World Tree" is a man-made
structure, just like I thought...

rows.label: qst650515_msg0004
rows.name:
The Bionis and Mechonis are huge, but
this World Tree may be even bigger.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0005
rows.name:
Yes, it's even bigger than the White
Whale. Alst looks so tiny below us...

rows.label: qst650515_msg0006
rows.name:
Believe it or not, there's a man who
made it up here all by himself...

rows.label: qst650515_msg0007
rows.name: By himself?

rows.label: qst650515_msg0008
rows.name:
We all worked together to get
this far. That's incredible...

rows.label: qst650515_msg0009
rows.name:
It seems inefficient. One person's
abilities are sorely limited.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0010
rows.name:
That's why we form teams and try
to accomplish greater things.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0011
rows.name: I agree.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0012
rows.name:
In a sense, the
Driver-and-Blade pairing could
also be called one such unit.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0013
rows.name: Definitely!

rows.label: qst650515_msg0014
rows.name:
It's only because I had
Hikari, Homura, and all of
you, that I made it this far.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0015
rows.name:
And now KOS-MOS Re:, Elma,
and all of us are here too...

rows.label: qst650515_msg0016
rows.name:
Yes. We can infer that this
will let us reach even greater
heights and go farther.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0017
rows.name: Anyway, it's very mysterious...

rows.label: qst650515_msg0018
rows.name: What's that?

rows.label: qst650515_msg0019
rows.name:
...Why did we all gather here...
No, why were we brought together?

rows.label: qst650515_msg0020
rows.name:
Because it was the Nopon Great
Sage's dream, right?

rows.label: qst650515_msg0021
rows.name: Yes, right. He did say that.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0022
rows.name:
But I feel this meeting
means something... I
don't know why, I just do.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0023
rows.name:
Sorry. That sounds
strange, doesn't it?

rows.label: qst650515_msg0024
rows.name:
No. I feel something
like that too, Elma.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0025
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Think ] Those words I heard back then...

rows.label: qst650515_msg0026
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Think ] All life, walking hand in hand...

rows.label: qst650515_msg0027
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Think ] Maybe this is it. I hope so...

rows.label: qst650515_msg0028
rows.name:
Everyone, you seem to be
enjoying the conversation, but
what about the investigation?

rows.label: qst650515_msg0029
rows.name:
Oops, I forgot. Let's finish
it quickly and move on!

rows.label: qst650515_msg0030
rows.name:
Agreed. There's a lot
we've got to do still.

rows.label: qst650515_msg0031
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] I'll train myself in this
world, and someday uncover
the secrets of planet Mira...
